subject: [PATCH nfs-utils 3/7] exports: describe the kernel's export features with struct nfsd_export_policy

2026-10-16.patch_summary: This patch renames the `struct export_features` to `struct nfsd_export_policy` and updates various parts of the code to use the new name consistently. The change is purely cosmetic, as the functionality remains the same. The patch also updates the function `get_export_features()` to return a pointer to `struct nfsd_export_policy` instead of `struct export_features`. This change is part of a larger series of patches that aim to improve the kernel's export features and policy handling.
